The Global Access Control Event

Not Justa Conference.

The Access Control Summit is where the industry’s most important conversations happen. Now in its fourth year, ACS brings together C-suite executives, founders, and thought leaders from across access control, smart lock technology, and adjacent sectors.

This year we’re heading to New Zealand, co-hosted with Gallagher Security. With just 150 seats, ACS26 is built for depth — real relationships, frank exchange, and the kind of clarity that only comes when the right people are finally in the same room.

New Zealand is a long flight. We know. So we’ve built a full week around it.

Mainstream Moment — 4 Panel Topics

What We'reTalking About.

01
Panel Topic One
From Doors to Identity
The industry is shifting from hardware and credentials to software platforms, data, and identity. Who owns the customer relationship when the technology layer evolves?
02
Panel Topic Two
Capital Shapes Strategy
Private equity, strategic acquirers, and public markets are reshaping the landscape. What does it mean to lead when financial discipline and growth expectations are in constant tension?
03
Panel Topic Three
Legacy Meets Reinvention
Every established player navigating the same tension — a profitable installed base and a future that demands something different. When do you protect the core, and when do you cannibalize it?
04
Panel Topic Four
People Build Platforms
Technology and capital get the headlines, but execution is a people problem. Talent, leadership, org design — the human bottlenecks that determine whether a strategy actually lands.

FAQ

Questions.

The ACS26 event takes place entirely in Hamilton, New Zealand across two days:

• Tuesday, October 6 — Welcome Reception at Gallagher House, Hamilton
• Wednesday, October 7 — Full Mainstream Moment at BNZ Theatre, Hamilton Central

Hamilton is approximately 2.5 hours south of Auckland. We strongly recommend booking a hotel in Hamilton for the nights of October 6 and 7.
For the event (Tue Oct 6 & Wed Oct 7): stay in Hamilton. The commute from Auckland is 2.5 hours each way and is not practical for two days. Two excellent hotels are walking distance from BNZ Theatre:
Recommended Hamilton Hotels
Novotel Hamilton Tainui — 7 Alma Street · 6-minute walk to BNZ Theatre · Primary recommendation
Ibis Hamilton Tainui — Also centrally located · Secondary option
If you want to join the optional Monday or Thursday activities in Auckland, stay in Auckland on those nights. We provide hosted coach transfers in both directions so no car is needed. All hotel costs are entirely at your own expense for both cities.
Hotel accommodation is not included in registration and is entirely at your own expense. We’ve identified the best Hamilton hotels near the venue and will share room block details and rates once you’re registered.
We provide hosted coach transfers in both directions:

• Tuesday morning: Coach departs Auckland → Hamilton (~2.5 hrs)
• Thursday morning: Coach returns Hamilton → Auckland

Hamilton Airport (HLZ) is 15 minutes from the venue for those flying directly. Most international attendees fly into Auckland Airport (AKL).
Completely optional — no obligation at all. Monday and Thursday activities are for attendees who want to explore Auckland and make a full New Zealand trip of it. The only required days are Tuesday (Welcome Day, Hamilton) and Wednesday (Mainstream Moment, Hamilton).
Registration covers: full access to the Mainstream Moment (Oct 7), the Welcome Reception at Gallagher House (Oct 6), all catering across both event days, the hosted Waiheke Island closing experience (Oct 8), and coach transfers between Auckland and Hamilton. Hotel accommodation is not included and is at the attendee’s own expense.
ACS26 opens with a Pōwhiri — a traditional Māori welcome ceremony performed by local iwi. A cultural liaison will brief all attendees beforehand. One of the most distinctive ways we’ve ever opened a summit.
Yes. All main event sessions will be professionally recorded and made available to registered attendees after the event.
